description: Returns what Overfit offers: products, typical user wishes mapped to the matching tool, documentation URLs, and `planned`, the list of upcoming features (e.g. sign-in and credit from the chat, API keys, tender alerts, data packages) with one value sentence each. Interest in a planned feature is recorded by interesse_melden. Suited to questions what Overfit offers, what is planned, or where the documentation is. No parameters.
name: overfit_catalog
title: Was bietet Overfit?
